articles.title: Union Budget 2026: India may widen gates for foreign goods as world hunts for destinations beyond the US
articles.summary: India's Union Budget 2026 will adopt a nuanced trade strategy: tightening restrictions on certain imports to protect domestic industries, while strategically opening doors to foreign goods that bolster local production. This 'Make in India' aligned approach aims to enhance national self-reliance and economic resilience, critical for India's strategic growth.

articles.title: Defence Ministry vows to stand ‘Shoulder to Shoulder’ with MACC on graft crackdown
articles.summary: Malaysia's Defence Ministry is collaborating with the Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission (MACC) to eradicate corruption and abuse of power within its ranks and the Armed Forces. This joint effort underscores a strong commitment to transparency and integrity, crucial for maintaining effective and credible defence institutions. Such initiatives are vital for national security and upholding public trust in the armed forces.
